evidence.redacted_summary: A public-project plan exposed two defaults that were not required by the user or repository.
The published Skill defaults interactions, artifacts, code comments, tests, logs, and internal errors to Traditional Chinese.
The published plan contract, template, and validator require an AI collaboration effectiveness section for every plan.

feedback.phenomenon: Every requirement plan includes AI collaboration measurement even when a public project does not request it.
feedback.expected_behavior: AI collaboration measurement should be disabled by default and enabled only by an explicit request or repository policy.
feedback.reproduction: Confirmed from the published required-section list, default template, and publication validator.

feedback.phenomenon: The Skill applies one fixed human-language default across interaction and target-repository artifacts.
feedback.expected_behavior: Interaction should follow the user, while files and code should follow target-repository rules and nearby conventions.
feedback.reproduction: Confirmed from the published language-policy section.

optimizations.intent_evidence: The Skill is a general planning workflow; AI timing is an optional measurement concern rather than a requirement-plan prerequisite.
optimizations.problem_evidence: The released reference, template, validator, and timing gate currently make the section part of every full-flow plan.
optimizations.scope: Requirement-plan section selection and reference timing activation.
optimizations.closure: Make the section and local timing opt-in, retain a reusable optional template, and update validator, tests, and public documentation.
optimizations.minimum_change: Keep the existing measurement capability but remove it from the default plan path.
optimizations.regression_case: A default plan omits the section; an explicitly enabled plan can still include and validate every measurement field.
optimizations.generalized_value: Reduces irrelevant output and local measurement work for public and non-metric-driven projects.
optimizations.decision_reason: The user accepted an opt-in default while preserving the existing capability.

optimizations.intent_evidence: A repository-agnostic workflow must preserve the user's communication language and each target repository's conventions.
optimizations.problem_evidence: The released Skill currently applies Traditional Chinese as the default to both interaction and repository artifacts.
optimizations.scope: Language selection for interaction, plans, tests, code comments, logs, errors, and fixed identifiers.
optimizations.closure: Separate interaction language from artifact language, define evidence priority, preserve identifiers, and add mixed-language regression scenarios.
optimizations.minimum_change: Replace the fixed default policy without translating existing public documentation or contracts.
optimizations.regression_case: Chinese and English users receive matching interaction language while target-repository files retain their documented conventions.
optimizations.generalized_value: Makes the public Skill usable across repositories without forcing unrelated language rewrites.
optimizations.decision_reason: The user accepted the adaptive policy used by the maintainer design.
